tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
tasks.description:
创建 Note 模型用于存储笔记。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 note.py 文件，定义 Note 类，包含以下字段: id (唯一标识符), content (笔记内容), created_at (创建时间)。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 设置数据库迁移
tasks.description:
配置数据库迁移以支持 Note 模型。在 app/migrations/ 目录下创建迁移文件，初始化数据库表结构，确保 Note 模型的字段正确映射到数据库。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记API
tasks.description:
创建笔记的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 目录下创建 notes.py 文件，定义 POST 和 GET 路由，分别用于创建和获取笔记。确保路由与 Note 模型交互，返回正确的 JSON 响应。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记前端页面
tasks.description:
创建笔记管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 目录下创建 notes.html 文件，包含一个表单用于输入笔记内容，以及一个列表用于显示已保存的笔记。表单提交时调用 POST API，页面加载时调用 GET API。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 实现前后端集成
tasks.description:
测试并集成前后端功能。在前端页面中调用后端 API，确保笔记的创建和显示功能正常工作。修复可能的接口调用或数据格式问题。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Note model with fields like title, content, and timestamps in the backend framework.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports necessary validations and relationships if required.

T2.implementation_approach: Generate and apply database migrations to create the notes table based on the Note model.
T2.notes: Use migration tools provided by the framework to handle schema changes.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes (create, read, update, delete).
T3.notes: Secure the API with authentication and proper error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Build a frontend page with forms and lists to display, create, and edit notes using a modern UI framework.
T4.notes: Ensure the UI is responsive and user-friendly.

T5.implementation_approach: Connect the frontend to the backend API using HTTP requests to enable real-time data interaction.
T5.notes: Test the integration thoroughly to ensure smooth communication between frontend and backend.
